name: plugin.google_styleguide_auditor
description: Google Style Guide auditor and linter config generator for Python, C++, TypeScript, Java, and Shell.

entrypoints.name: styleguide_audit_file
entrypoints.description: Audit a source code file against Google style rules (Python, C++, TypeScript, Java, Shell)

entrypoints.name: styleguide_get_rule
entrypoints.description: Query specific Google style guidelines and best-practice rationales by language and topic

entrypoints.name: styleguide_generate_linter_config
entrypoints.description: Emit Google-compliant configuration files (.pylintrc, .clang-format, or style settings)

parameters.name: target_dir
parameters.description: Directory to emit configuration into (default returns text)
